options.text: A spherical molecule of 60 carbon atoms
A single layer of carbon atoms arranged in hexagons
A stack of hexagonal carbon layers with weak forces between them
A cylindrical tube of carbon atoms

questions.explanation: Graphene is a single layer of graphite - a one-atom-thick sheet of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal pattern. Each carbon atom is bonded to 3 others, with one delocalised electron per atom. It is the thinnest known material.

questions.stem: Why can buckminsterfullerene (C60) be used for drug delivery?

options.text: It is extremely hard and can cut through cell walls
It has a hollow cage-like structure that can trap drug molecules inside
It conducts electricity and can stimulate cells

questions.explanation: Buckminsterfullerene (C60) has a spherical, hollow cage-like structure made of 60 carbon atoms. This cage can trap other atoms or molecules inside it, making it useful for drug delivery by encapsulating drugs and delivering them to specific cells in the body.
